def solve_n_queens(n):
    cols = []
    diag1 = set()  # row - col
    diag2 = set()  # row + col
    
    def backtrack(r):
        if r == n:
            return True
        for c in range(n):
            if c in cols or (r - c) in diag1 or (r + c) in diag2:
                continue
            cols.append(c)
            diag1.add(r - c)
            diag2.add(r + c)
            if backtrack(r + 1):
                return True
            cols.pop()
            diag1.remove(r - c)
            diag2.remove(r + c)
        return False
    
    if backtrack(0):
        return cols
    return None

solution = solve_n_queens(11)
